previously.why: fourteen of those seventeen were this fish's own pale skin, which renders at about (0.78, 0.44, 0.76) under a magenta world and sat inside that window by one part in two hundred on green. The backdrop itself renders with green below 0.063 everywhere measured. A ray cast through each failing pixel found solid front-facing skin at every one, and five corrections to the geometry moved the count by nothing at all.

note: the tool counts pixels over the whole frame; what is left is three isolated pixels at the far edge of it where a surface one polygon thick loses its back face. The shipped body material is double-sided, so none of them arise at runtime at all -- the cull is the worst case a single-sided renderer would draw.
